name: Git Workflow, Branching & Evidence-Backed Review
purpose: Keep changes isolated, reviewable, and traceable with focused branches or worktrees, small conventional commits, secret-free history, and pull requests carrying test evidence and acceptance mapping.
inputs: Active Goal or task definition with acceptance criteria the branch must satisfy
Base branch and remote state (status, recent log, fetch freshness)
Repository conventions: commit format, maximum change size, required reviewers
Worktree or branch naming scheme for the change
outputs: Merged change on the base branch as one traceable unit
PR documentation: scope, acceptance mapping, coverage delta, risk and rollback notes
Clean local state: branch deleted, worktree pruned, history invariants intact
stop_conditions: PR merged with required approvals, green CI, and acceptance criteria mapped to evidence
Change formally rejected in review with recorded rationale and follow-ups filed
Worktree and branch cleaned up with nothing unpushed or stashed
